MacroName wizard_camera

##################DO NOT EDIT ANYTHING IN THIS SCRIPT!#############
# Name: wizard_camera
# Author: Simon Fromm
# Version: 1.0.1
# SerialEM version: 4.2.X or higher
# Last update: 19.06.2026
# Support: simon.fromm@embl.de
# DOES NOT WORK AS STANDALONE. Needs to be called via the LowDoseWizard script
###################################################################

SuppressReports

Echo
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo Starting LowDoseWizard CAMERA routine
Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Echo

#################################################
# Read in camera config file
#################################################

ReportSystemPath
ReadStringsFromFile camera $repVal1\wizard_camera_config.txt
CallStringArray camera

#################################################
# Check if parameter file from previous session is present
#################################################

IsTextFileOpen PAR
If $repVal1 == 1
   paramnew = 1
   reload = 0
   SkipTo Prompts
Else
   paramnew = 0
Endif

ReportDirectory
dir = $repVal1
DoesFileExist $dir\ldw_parameters.txt
If $repVal1 == 0
   paramfile = 0
   reload = 0
   SkipTo Prompts
Elseif $repVal1 == 1
   paramfile = 1
   YesNoBox A LowDoseWizard parameters file has been found inside the current working directory. Do you want to use it instead of defining new parameters?
   If $repVal1 == 1
      ReadStringsFromFile param $dir\ldw_parameters.txt
      CallStringArray param
      IsVariableDefined fluenceR
      If $repVal1 == 0
         OKBox A faulty or incomplete parameter file has been loaded. It's best to delete the file and restart the LowDoseWizard.
         Exit A faulty or incomplete parameter file has been loaded. It's best to delete the file and restart the LowDoseWizard.
      Endif
      IsVariableDefined foil_type
      If $repVal1 == 0
         OKBox A faulty or incomplete parameter file has been loaded. It's best to delete the file and restart the LowDoseWizard.
         Exit A faulty or incomplete parameter file has been loaded. It's best to delete the file and restart the LowDoseWizard.
      Endif
      Echo Using existing parameters file.
      reload = 1
      SkipTo Execution
   Elseif $repVal1 == 0
      reload = 0
      SkipTo Prompts
   Endif
Endif

#################################################
# User prompts
#################################################
Prompts:

IsVariableDefined type
If $repVal1 == 0
   If $EnableTomo == 0
      type := 2
   Else
      ParseQuotedStrings 1
      header = { 'Is this a' }
      prompt1 = { '1: Tomo OR' }
      prompt2 = { '2: SPA session?' }
      buttons = { '1:Tomo' '2: SPA'}
      ThreeChoiceBox header prompt1 prompt2 buttons
      If $repVal1 == 1
         Echo This is a Tomo session.
         type := 1
      ElseIf $repVal1 == 2
         Echo This is a SPA session.
         type := 2
      Endif
   Endif
Endif
ParseQuotedStrings 0

If $type == 1
   EnterDefaultedNumber $FluenceR_tomo 1 Which fluence (dose) per tilt in e-/A^2 do you want to have?
   fluenceR := $repVal1
   Echo Fluence per tilt chosen to be $fluenceR e-/A^2.
   Echo
ElseIf $type == 2
   EnterDefaultedNumber $FluenceR_SPA -1 Which fluence (dose) in e-/A^2 do you want your record exposures to have?
   fluenceR := $repVal1
   Echo Fluence per exposure chosen to be $fluenceR e-/A^2.
   Echo
   IsVariableDefined foil_type
   If $repVal1 == 0
      ParseQuotedStrings 1
      header = { 'What support foil (NOT mesh) material does your grid have?' }
      prompt1 = { 'Carbon, e.g. Quantifoil or C-flat' }
      prompt2 = { 'Gold, e.g. UltrAuFoil or HexAuFoil' }
      buttons = { 'Carbon' 'Gold' }
      ThreeChoiceBox header prompt1 prompt2 buttons
      If $repVal1 == 1
         foil_type := 0
         Echo Foil material chosen to be carbon.
      ElseIf $repVal1 == 2
         foil_type := 1
         Echo Foil material chosen to be gold.
      Endif
      ParseQuotedStrings 0
   Endif
Endif

#################################################
# Jump to here if parameter file is used
#################################################

Execution:

#################################################
# Calibrate dose and caluclate exposures times
#################################################
MoveToNavItem $empty

# Set Preview camera settings for dose calibration
CallFunction set_camera $ExposureTimeP_flux $BinP $FracP $FramesP $AlignP $PluginP $ModeP $ProcP P

# Calculate and determine exposure time to get user defined e-/A^2 in record
GoToLowDoseArea R
SetColumnOrGunValve 1
ScreenDown
Pause Please center the beam with DIRECT ALIGNMENTS --> Tomo Beam shift; Then click Yes to continue.
ScreenUp
If $EnergyFilter == 1
   If $UseSerialEMRefineZLP == 1
      RefineZLP
      If $EnergyFilterType == 1
         Pause Optional: You can perform daily Selectris tuning (Isochomaticity/Distortions) in Sherpa now; \
         Then click Yes to contiune.
      Endif
   Elseif $UseSerialEMRefineZLP == 0
      If $EnergyFilterType == 1
         Pause Please perform "Center ZLP" and optionally daily Selctris tuning (Isochromaticity/Distortions) \
         in Sherpa now; Then click Yes to continue.
      Elseif $EnergyFilterType == 2
         Pause Please perform "Center ZLP" in Digital Micrograph; Then click Yes to continue.
      Endif
   Endif
Endif
Delay 3 sec
L
ElectronStats
fluxP = $repVal5
fluxP-round = ROUND $fluxP 1
SetBinning R 1
ReportCurrentPixelSize R
pixR = $repVal1 * 10
pix2R = $pixR * $pixR
fluxRA = $fluxP / $pix2R
timeR =  $fluenceR / $fluxRA
timeR-round = ROUND $timeR 2
CalibrateElectronDose

# Preview
If $type == 1
   timeP = $FluenceP_tomo / $fluxRA
   If $timeP < $ExposureTime_min
      timeP = $ExposureTime_min
      timeP-round = $ExposureTime_min
   Else
      timeP-round = ROUND $timeP 2
   Endif
ElseIf $type == 2
   timeP = $ExposureTimeP_SPA
Endif

# Focus
If $type == 1
   timeF = $FluenceF_tomo / $fluxRA
ElseIf $type == 2
   timeF = $ExposureTimeF_SPA
Endif

# Trial
timeT = $timeF

# View
If $CondenserConfig == 2
   GoToLowDoseArea V
   Delay 3 sec
   GoToLowDoseArea R
   Delay 3 sec
   GoToLowDoseArea V
   SetLDAddedBeamButton
   ScreenDown
   Pause Please center the beam with the left TRACKBALL; Then click Yes to continue.
   ScreenUp
   SetLDAddedBeamButton 0
Endif

CallFunction set_camera $ExposureTimeV_flux $BinV $FracV $FramesV $AlignV $PluginV $ModeV $ProcV V
V
ElectronStats
fluxV = $repVal5
SetBinning V 1
ReportCurrentPixelSize V
pixV = $repVal1 * 10
pix2V = $pixV * $pixV
fluxVA = $fluxV / $pix2V
If $type == 1
   timeV = $FluenceV_tomo / $fluxVA
   If $timeV < $ExposureTime_min
      timeV = $ExposureTime_min
   Endif
ElseIf $type == 2
   timeV = $FluenceV_SPA / $fluxVA
   If $timeV < $ExposureTime_min
      timeV = $ExposureTime_min
   Endif
Endif

# Search
If $type == 1
   modeS = $ModeS_zlp
   binS = $BinS_tomo
   CallFunction set_camera $ExposureTimeS_flux $binS $FracS $FramesS $AlignS $PluginS $modeS $ProcS S
   Search
   ElectronStats
   fluxS = $repVal5
   SetBinning S 1
   ReportCurrentPixelSize S
   pixS = $repVal1 * 10
   pix2S = $pixS * $pixS
   fluxSA = $fluxS / $pix2S
   timeS = $FluenceS_tomo / $fluxSA
   If $timeS > $ExposureTimeS_max
      timeS = $ExposureTimeS_max
   Endif
ElseIf $type == 2
   binS = $BinS_SPA
   If $foil_type == 0
      timeS = $ExposureTimeS_SPA_zlp
      modeS = $ModeS_zlp
   Elseif $foil_type == 1
      If $EnergyFilter == 1
         timeS = $ExposureTimeS_SPA_plasmon
         modeS = $ModeS_plasmon
      Else
         timeS = $ExposureTimeS_SPA_zlp
         modeS = $ModeS_zlp
      Endif
   Endif
Endif

#################################################
# Set camera parameters for each low dose area
#################################################

# Preview
CallFunction set_camera $timeP $BinP $FracP $FramesP $AlignP $PluginP $ModeP $ProcP P

# Record
CallFunction set_camera $timeR $BinR $FracR $FramesR $AlignR $PluginR $ModeR $ProcR R

# Focus
CallFunction set_camera $timeF $BinF $FracF $FramesF $AlignF $PluginF $ModeF $ProcF F

# Trial
CallFunction set_camera $timeT $BinT $FracT $FramesT $AlignT $PluginT $ModeT $ProcT T

# View
CallFunction set_camera $timeV $BinV $FracV $FramesV $AlignV $PluginV $ModeV $ProcV V

# Search
CallFunction set_camera $timeS $binS $FracS $FramesS $AlignS $PluginS $modeS $ProcS S

#################################################
# Make variables persistent
#################################################

MakeVarPersistent ModeV
MakeVarPersistent timeV
MakeVarPersistent modeS
MakeVarPersistent timeS
MakeVarPersistent timeR-round
MakeVarPersistent fluxP-round
MakeVarPersistent pixR

#################################################
# Write parameter file
#################################################

If $paramnew == 1
   SkipTo Writing
Elseif $paramnew == 0
   If $paramfile == 1
      If $reload == 1
         SkipTo Finish
      Elseif $reload == 0
         OpenTextFile PAR A 0 $dir\ldw_parameters.txt
         SkipTo Writing
      Endif
   Elseif $paramfile == 0
      OpenTextFile PAR O 0 $dir\ldw_parameters.txt
      SkipTo Writing
   Endif
Endif

Writing:

WriteLineToFile PAR fluenceR := $fluenceR

If $paramnew == 0
   If $reload == 0
      CloseTextFile PAR
      SkipTo Finish
   Endif
   If $paramnew == 0
      CloseTextFile PAR
      SkipTo Finish
   Endif
Endif

#################################################
# Closing messages
#################################################
Finish:

If $type == 1
   OKBox Completed LowDoseWizard CAMERA routine. Record exposure time is $timeR-round sec, Preview exposure time is $timeP-round sec.
   Echo
   Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
   Echo Completed LowDoseWizard CAMERA routine.
   Echo Record exposure time is $timeR-round sec, Preview exposure time is $timeP-round sec.
   Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
   Echo
ElseIf $type == 2
   OKBox Completed LowDoseWizard CAMERA routine. Record exposure time is $timeR-round sec.
   Echo
   Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
   Echo Completed LowDoseWizard CAMERA routine.
   Echo Record exposure time is $timeR-round sec.
   Echo +++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
   Echo
Endif
